messages:
tara chen: Heads up — during today's change window the rollout for r-1023 was auto-paused by the deploy-bot because of a guard hit on /v1/generate. It looks like a brief shard-warming spike, not an actual model regression. Anyone have the logs?

alex r: saw it. backend reported increased 503s for ~70s while new nodes finished warmup. deploy-bot flagged on the error_rate guard (configured with window=60s).

lia ng: which exact guard rule? we have both error_rate and quality_regression checks on that route.

kevin m: guard config for that rollout:
```json
{"route":"/v1/generate","guards":[{"type":"error_rate","threshold":0.003,"window_seconds":60},{"type":"latency_p95","threshold_ms":1200,"window_seconds":120}]}
```
(deployed via infra-configs/rollout-guards)

samir: root cause: infra autoscaler added capacity and some nodes returned 503s while caches populated. Short-lived. We shouldn't pause the rollout for <2m transient spikes. Proposing we add a grace_window_seconds to the guard schema and a secondary check that requires sustained slope or sustained high absolute failures.

deploy-bot: auto-pause: rollout r-1023 paused by guard error_rate (0.35% over 60s). To resume: manual approve or wait for operator override. /rollouts/r-1023

tara chen: thanks @alex @samir — sounds right. Two proposals: 1) add grace_window_seconds default 120s for error_rate guards, 2) add a telemetry metric "rollout_guard_pause_reasons" to surface false positives in the console.

alex r: +1 for grace window. Also suggest we check traffic-weight slope: if traffic ramp is increasing fast, tolerate slightly higher transient error rate (warmup expected). Could add: allow_error_rate_until_traffic_change=true.

lia ng: I'll update the guard schema draft. Quick sketch:
```yaml
- type: error_rate
  threshold: 0.003
  window_seconds: 60
  grace_window_seconds: 120  # don't auto-pause unless breach persists
  require_sustained: true    # needs X consecutive windows
```

kevin m: we should also avoid noisy alerts in telemetry. Add a new alert rule: "guard_pause_qualified" that only fires if deploy-bot pause + guard_reason persists > grace_window. That way pager and console alerts align.

samir: action items: @lia update schema PR today, @alex add slope-aware condition in runtime, @kevin add telemetry alert change, @tara file a short RFC with examples and rollout UX mock for console (show last 10m weighting and pause reasons). I'll open a follow-up thread for rollout UX.

tara chen: created RFC: https://go/rollout-grace-rfc (draft). cc @deploy-bot (to later change behaviour once we have config).

alex r: will try a small backend patch to ignore single-window spikes for feature branches.

lia ng: PR incoming for guard schema and tests.

kevin m: I'll add a Grafana tile to the per-release dashboard showing rolling weight + error annotations so oncall can eyeball warmups quickly.

samir: thanks all. For today let's manually resume r-1023 after we confirm error trend is back to baseline.

deploy-bot: note: manual resume performed by tara chen at 1845432175. Rollout resumed to 10% traffic.

tara chen: confirmed resumed and monitoring. will follow up in RFC thread with concrete defaults. :thumbsup:
